script_hooks.logic:
Given arg1, arg2, arg3.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg1.
Let ability be the id of the move labelled arg2 on executer.
Executer uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityTag: arg2}, {abilityTag: arg3, abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect, conditions: {anyCanHit: true}}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "01"}]]}, conditions: {anyCanHit: true}}].

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let v be this state → retrieve-register-ability-conf with (arg).
Let ability be this state → get-ability-id-from-conf with (arg, v).
If ability is the id of the move labelled "steal_attack" on executer, then call helper with (arg, "steal_attack", "steal_self").
Otherwise, if ability is the id of the move labelled "mug_attack" on executer, then call helper with (arg, "mug_attack", "mug_self").
Otherwise, executer uses ability with options v's 'abilityOptions'.
